    "Model forecasts are consistently 0.1-0.3 units too low for the first 7 days, correcting to match true outcomes within 0.1 units by day 10-12",

    "Model under-predicts price peaks by 0.8-1.2 units on days 18-22 compared to true outcomes, showing lagging behind rapid price movements",
    "Mean reversion bias: model maintains levels too close to recent range (77-79), while true prices more frequently reach boundaries at 76.2 or 80+",
    "Sentiment turning from positive (0.67+) to mixed (0.33-0.50) correlates with 0.1-0.2 unit price deceleration on 3-5 day lag",
    "When history shows continuous price progression over 4+ days, model needs +0.15 per progressive day offset to match trajectory"
